# GOAL explainer, shot list (v2.0)

Rebuild reference for the motion explainer in `goal-explainer.html`. v2.0 keeps the v1.8 story, beat order and every line of copy, and restyles it around one blue dot: each scene is a flat full bleed field (dark, blue or white) built around one circle, each scene opens with one oversized word taken from its own copy, and every cut passes through a circle (a flood that grows from the dot, or an iris that closes on it). Stage is 1920 by 1080 (portrait 1080 by 1920). Times are from the start of the piece (global) with the scene local time in parentheses, in seconds unless marked.

## Global spec

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Frame | Landscape 1920 by 1080, 16:9, scaled to fit. On a viewport taller than it is wide the page switches to a portrait stage of 1080 by 1920 (9:16) with the same five scenes reflowed into one column (text on top, visuals below, hero words stacked). Render landscape as the master and portrait as a second deliverable. |
| Type | Sora 800 for hero words, headlines, counters, recap lines and the tagline. Outfit for everything else (eyebrows, labels, captions, form text), weights 400 to 800. Hero words are all caps, tracking -0.045em, line height 0.8. Headlines 64px (scene 4: 60px, scene 1: 88px), tracking -0.025em, line height 1.08. Eyebrows 28px weight 700 uppercase, tracking 0.08em. UI labels 28px, captions 32px. Nothing under 28px on the stage. Portrait: headlines 60px (scene 4: 56px, scene 1: 80px). |
| Fields | Scene 1 dark #080C10. Scene 2 blue #057BE5. Scene 3 white. Scene 4 dark. Scene 5 opens blue and irises to dark for the logo. One solid color per field, no gradients, no drop shadows, no glass. |
| Color | Dark #080C10, blue #057BE5 (pressed #0C6EC5), light blue #339FFF for blue text and icons on dark, white. Neutrals from v1: #0D1117, #151A1E, #B8C4D0, #94A3B8 (non-converting clicks), #475569, #334155 (device frames on dark). Device screens keep the light palette (ink #0F1B2D, #2B3442, #6A7482, lines #E3E8EF, skeletons #D6DCE5 and #EFF2F7). Mint #3BEECA only on the two lead checks in scene 4. Text on blue is white, text on white is #080C10, eyebrow on white is blue, eyebrow on dark is light blue. No magenta, violet, orange or yellow. |
| Outlines | Objects carry a bold flat outline: 4px #080C10 on the blue and white fields (desktop window, phone at 6px, slots, form panel, lead cards), #334155 on dark. The phone in front of the desktop has a 10px ring in the field color to separate it. |
| The dot | The continuity device. Blue #057BE5 everywhere it sits on dark or white (the click, every traveling click, each lead, the iris, the radar mark center). On the blue field it is white (scene 2) or blue with an 8px white ring (scene 5), so it stays visible. |
| Hero words | One per scene from that scene's copy: scene 2 YOUR AD (its eyebrow), scene 3 6 IN 10 (from beat A, always on screen with "About ... on average" and the AVERAGE label), scene 4 EVERY LEAD (its eyebrow). Scene 1 uses the radar mark as its hero and scene 5 the tagline. In scenes 2 and 4 the word opens around the dot, holds about a second, then shrinks into the eyebrow slot and hands off to the Outfit eyebrow. |
| Halftone | Scene 3's 6 IN 10 is a field of blue dots on a 14px grid (12px portrait). Dot radius follows letter coverage and shrinks to half toward the bottom right. Drawn on a canvas from the master clock. |
| Transitions | Circle wipes only. Scene 1 to 2: the dot floods blue. Scene 2 to 3: the white counter disc floods white. Scene 3 to 4: one lead dot lifts to frame center and the frame irises in on it, leaving the dot on dark. Scene 4 to 5: the first inbox lead's dot floods blue. Inside scene 5 the collapsed dot floods dark. Floods are 500 to 520ms, ease in-out cubic. |
| Standard motion | Ease-out cubic (0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) for fades. Springs use an ease-out with slight overshoot (back, c1 = 1.5). Text rises 14px over 450ms; headline words in scenes 1 and 5 rise 30 to 46px with overshoot, 70 to 80ms stagger. Beat swap: outgoing headline fades and lifts 12px over 350ms, incoming rises 300ms after it starts. |
| Chrome | Five progress segments top right, each 112 by 6px, 10px gap, recolored per field (white fill on blue, blue fill on dark and white). No wordmark in the top bar: the brand opens and closes the piece. Captions sit in a solid #080C10 pill, 32px Outfit 500 white, centered in the bottom 112px. In the autoplay build captions are hidden and each scene centers in the frame. |
| Device pair | A 940 by 800 composite (portrait 888 by 740). Desktop window 760 by 600 at top left: white, 4px outline, 20px radius, 58px title bar with three outlined 16px dots and an outlined address pill. Phone 380 by 760 at bottom right, 6px outline, 56px radius. Ad card has a 4px blue outline. |
| Cursor | 44px arrow pointer, white fill, 2.2px #080C10 stroke, no shadow. Travels on a shallow arc (24px lift), ease in-out. A click is a 240ms press (scale 1 to 0.85 to 1) with the tap dot and an 88px ring at the tip. |
| Tap | Blue 28px dot with a 5px white halo pops 0.4 to 1 (220ms, overshoot). A 124px ring (4px blue) expands 0.25 to 1.2 and fades from 80 percent to 0 over 700ms. The dot shrinks away over 300ms, 900ms after the tap. |
| Checks | Inline SVG check, 2.6 to 3.2px rounded stroke, draws along its path over 320 to 450ms, ease-out. |
| Icons | One line set, 2px rounded strokes: check, search, inbox, form. |
| Assets | goal-mark-400.png (radar mark), goal-wordmark-white-1200.png. The radar mark's center dot sits at 49.25 by 50.25 percent of the image and is 17.75 percent of its width; the wordmark's O is centered at 40.25 by 50 percent and spans 26.17 percent of its width. Logos only fade or scale; never recolored, stretched, rotated, masked or halftoned, with clear space kept. |
| Audio | None. Designed to be understood with sound off. |

v1 ran 45 s. Scene 4 is 3.1 s longer: the eye has its own beat before the forms fill, and the footnote now holds 4.8 s so it can be read twice (v1 held it 3 s). Scene 5 is 2.4 s longer for the logo build. Scene 2 is 1.55 s longer for its opening word. Scene 1 is 0.1 s longer and scene 3 is 0.1 s shorter.

## Notes for the editor

- Every beat is 12 words or fewer. The only figure in the piece is "6 in 10", and the 6 IN 10 hero word is only ever on screen with "About 6 in 10 clicks become leads, on average."
- Scene 3 must show exactly six blue lead cards and four gray non-converting clicks. Every paid mark lives in the PAID CLICKS row: a check stays in the slot each click left. Lead cards and the gray group carry no paid mark, because the agency pays for the click and a lead is what some clicks become.
- The hero words repeat copy that is already on screen in the same scene (the eyebrow or beat A). They are decorative and hidden from screen readers.
- The blue dot is the continuity device: the radar mark's center in scene 1, the tap and click in scene 2 (white on the blue field), the ten clicks in scene 3, the iris and each lead in scene 4, and the radar mark's center again in scene 5.
- Logos only fade or scale. The scene 5 hand off from mark to wordmark is a scale down plus a cross fade, both centered on the O.
- The footnote in scene 4 stays small, muted and calm, and appears last.
- Desktop and phone always act together: the ad lands on both screens, a cursor clicks on desktop while a thumb taps on the phone, and in scene 4 both forms fill at once and each produces its own lead.
- Reduced motion shows each scene at rest (beat B, final counters, all leads placed) with Previous and Next, including in the clean build. Scene 5 at rest stacks the recap above the brand block on dark.
- Form values are placeholders. Replace with other generic values if needed, but never with real customer data.
